apw-acta-pacis-westphalicae.method: Search listing per volume (/search/query.html?titleAPW_str=<vol>&rows=100) to enumerate all 'dok' records, then per-document TEI XML (/ObjectComponent/project.getObject?id=<id>); removed modern editorial parts (headings, dating/transmission/docNum description divs, foot notes of type edd, expansions of abbreviations); kept the document text (original abbreviations as printed in the edition).
apw-acta-pacis-westphalicae.coverage: Partial: 3210 of 14,545 listed document records (22%) harvested, from 19 of 41 volumes (APW I 1: 39, APW II A 1: 390, APW II A 2: 253, APW II A 3: 149, APW II A 4: 302, APW II A 5: 293, APW II A 7: 31, APW II A 8: 90, APW II B 1: 257, APW II B 2: 176, APW II B 3,1: 132, APW II B 3,2: 105, APW II B 4: 188, APW II B 5,1: 74, APW II B 5,2: 97, APW II B 6: 125, APW II C 1: 310, APW II C 2: 156, APW II C 3: 43). The crawl stopped at a self-imposed 4-hour budget because the BSB server answered intermittently with 502/504 and timeouts (about 8-12 documents per minute); documents that failed once were not retried. Within Series I and II A-C the volumes are only partly covered (documents that failed once were skipped, and the crawl went volume by volume); Series II C 4, and all of Series III (protocols, negotiation papers, diaries, varia) are unharvested; they can be resumed with scripts/apw-acta-pacis-westphalicae.py (files are cached). Excluded by design: introductions, prefaces, source lists, registers, headings, archival descriptions and footnotes of the edition.
problems: Partial harvest only (see coverage); the site was unstable (502 Bad Gateway, maintenance page, timeouts).

The edition is a modern critical edition of period documents; the German text in Series I-III is the archival original (German, French, Latin, Swedish), but editorial insertions in square brackets and the line-break hyphenation of the printed edition remain in the text.
Year from the document's dateline (date@when); documents without date fall back to a year in the title.

bakfj-friedrich-johann.method: Listing pages /doc/search?page=1..170 (session cookie) to get all 3385 document numbers and the 'Editing completed' flag; then /print/<Nr> for each completed document; kept the part of #text after the German summary (the edited source text), dropped the Regest, metadata, indices and apparatus tabs
bakfj-friedrich-johann.coverage: 302 documents with an edited source text staged (catalogue says about 330). Not fetched: the 1,367 metadata-only entries (a sample of 13 had no source text) and 4 flagged-completed entries whose number has a letter suffix or no number (e.g. 185a, 198a, 603a); 'Kabinettstuecke' (12 documents) not included.
problems: Catalogue figure (330 texts) is higher than the 302 found: the difference is probably the 4 unfetched entries, the 'Kabinettstuecke' and texts added since the catalogue count.
Years from the metadata line; undated pieces ('zwischen 1510 und 1517') take the first year.

balassi-osszes-verse.method: No bulk export. Site is a set of HTML frames: poem list from kr98.htm / abc.htm, text frame of each poem (krit/r<nnnn>.htm), decoded as ISO-8859-2; kept only the critical-text frame (stripped verse and footnote numbers, apparatus/notes frames r*j/m/s/a not fetched).
balassi-osszes-verse.coverage: All 114 pages linked from the contents lists (poems, fragments, prose note).
problems: Text is the editor's critical text in modernised Hungarian spelling (original-spelling witnesses BC/FJK appear only in the apparatus, not harvested).

A few prose notes/headings by the editor (e.g. dedication lines, melody indications) are part of the poem frame and kept.

balkan-slavic-digital-editions.method: Found the portal's data JSON files by reading search_engine.php; downloaded 6 JSON files (lt, petka, sva, data_1, data_2) and rebuilt each text from the 'dipl' tokens.
balkan-slavic-digital-editions.coverage: All texts in the portal's corpora (Excerpts 22, Life of St Petka 16, Tale of Alexander 5, Pop Puncov Sbornik 85 chapters); only part falls within 1450-1700 (the Sbornik, 1796, is entirely outside).
problems: punco-073: several data blocks merged into one text

Texts rebuilt from the portal's own token-level JSON files (lt_data.json, petka_data.json, sva_data.json, data_1/2.json, linked from search_engine.php); diplomatic Latin transliteration column 'dipl' only (Cyrillic, lemmas, tags, English translations dropped). Editorial symbols alone as tokens (===, club, dagger) removed; critical-edition markers like [...] and *folio* numbers remain inside the text.

Dates are not in the data files: taken from the site's description pages and CLARIN.SI deposit 11356/1441 headers; those marked 'approximate' in the source field are estimates (century midpoints or decades). Texts known only by century that lies wholly in 1450-1700 (16th/17th c.) are year=None with dateless_in_window=True: Sofia Alexander edition, CIAI 1161 Satanael text, NBKM 709, BAR Ms.slav 287. Veles (15th c.), Odessa and Petersburg Alexander editions have no year on the site (undated, not counted in window).
Letters of Wallachian princes are three letters (1456-1481) in one record (the data has no letter boundary), year 1479.

Joseph-Volokolamsk 1537 manuscript is mentioned on the site but has no text in the data files; not harvested. Excerpts and Petka sources of 1450-1700 present: Vukovic 1536, Kozicic 1531, Letters, Rostovski 1689, Varlaam 1643, Tixonravov, Ljubljana, Kiev damaskin.
Same texts partly overlap the CLARIN.SI deposit 11356/1441 (23 texts), which was not harvested separately to avoid duplicates. License CC BY-SA 4.0 (site).

blotius-inventar-1576.method: Downloaded the TEI_SOURCE file; kept <text> with original-spelling readings (removed <reg>/<expan>).

Single record for the whole inventory (656 entries).

bodleian-first-folio.coverage: All 36 plays of the First Folio transcription.

bodley-diplomatic-correspondence.method: GitHub tarball (codeload) of livesandletters/bodley1 master; xml/<year>/*.xml (project-specific, non-TEI markup). bodley-diplomatic-correspondence.coverage: All 982 letter files with transcribed letter text of the 988 XML files in the repository (1585-1597); 6 files with no letter text (address leaf only or empty) skipped: DCB_0806.xml, DCB_0297.xml, DCB_0308.xml, DCB_1114.xml, DCB_0016.xml, DCB_0434.xml.

The 990 in the catalogue vs 988 XML files in the repo (the repo has year folders 1585-1597).

book-of-margery-kempe-selu.method: Showcase viewer page for the Wynkyn de Worde pamphlet (webapp_wynkyn.php) fetched once; folio divs parsed, diplomatic abbreviated forms kept (<span class=abbr>), expansions (<span class=expan>) and added marginal folio numbers dropped.
book-of-margery-kempe-selu.coverage: The Wynkyn de Worde pamphlet only (the one in-period text). The manuscript Book of Margery Kempe (BL Add. 61823, c. 1440) is out of window and was not harvested.

Year 1501 is the printed date 'c. 1501'.

boschdoc.method: Read config.json (939 entries) and each entry's JSON data file; one record per entry = plain text of the Transcription layer (Dutch/Spanish/English-labelled copies are identical; translations, comments and bibliographic notes excluded). boschdoc.coverage: All entries with a transcription; entries lacking one are skipped (counted in problems).

boyle-workdiaries.method: Crawled the 'text-only diplomatic transcript' page of each workdiary linked from /wd/view/view.html (robots.txt allows /wd/, Crawl-delay 10 respected). Only div.entry text kept; headnotes, folio markers, buttons stripped. Diplomatic version kept, editorial version skipped.

briefwisseling-constantijn-huygens.method: Not harvested. Probed robots.txt and the start page only.

Year from listing 'Año' (first year of a range).

Semi-diplomatic transcriptions with abbreviations expanded (italic in PDF, kept as plain text).

corpus-mallorca.method: No bulk download. Document list from the site's ajax_documentos.php (all ids), then each documento.php page; kept only the 'transcripcion paleografica' column (diplomatic), dropping facsimile links, line numbers, header block, regesto and the critical presentation.
corpus-mallorca.coverage: All 1251 documents in the corpus (1640-1909 per catalogue); out-of-window years kept in staging.

cosuiza.method: Document ids from the stats pages (action=stats&start=...), raw TEITOK XML from /cosuiza/xmlfiles/<id>.xml; plain text built from <tok> contents (transcription with expansions), without facsimile coordinates, lemmas or annotations; year from origDate.

dipko-schwarzenhorn-1649.method: Fetched /o:dipko.<id>/TEI_SOURCE for the 31 objects (travel diary rb, instruction i, secondary instruction ni, 26 letters l.*, final report fr, secret report gb), listed from the context pages; raw = <text> with notes and figure descriptions removed. resources.huygens.knaw.nl answers HTTP 403 Forbidden to the identified harvest user agent (including robots.txt and the start page); it serves pages only to browser-like agents. Spoofing a browser agent would circumvent the server's bot filtering, so no pages were fetched. No bulk export or alternative route found. Could be done with the publisher's permission or a whitelisted agent.

early-americas-digital-archive.method: Listed captures of the original MITH site (mith.umd.edu/eada) with the Wayback CDX API, picked the latest 200 capture of each text page html/display.php?docs=<id>.xml, and downloaded the raw capture (id_ form) at 1.5 s intervals. Extracted the text after the colophon header, dropping navigation, search form and line-number marks. One record per EADA text (poem, letter, narrative). Years are set by hand from the work's date of composition/first publication (the page gives only author dates and the source edition).
early-americas-digital-archive.coverage: 99 texts stored from 131 captured text pages; the author gateway pages captured by the Wayback Machine link to 115 text ids, 114 of which have a captured text page (99%). Texts are mostly modern scholarly editions of period texts (Eitner 1872, Szyrocki, Milch, etc.); each poem/epigram/play is its own record; some editorial apparatus may remain inside <text>.

4816 works whose date range straddles 1450 or 1700 (mostly authors of c.1690-1770 such as Tersteegen, Wernicke, Zinzendorf, Guenther, Hunold, Brockes, Stieler, Weise) were excluded as not wholly in-window and not fetched.
235 in-window works excluded as modern translations into German (Shakespeare/Schloesser, La Fontaine/Etzel, Montaigne/Bode, Navarra/Foerster, Moliere, Corneille, Cervantes, Calderon, Ariosto, etc.).

About 5,200 Digitale Bibliothek works carry no usable date; ~30 of them (Wickram, Gengenbach, Pauli, Schmeltzl, Reuter, Lalebuch 1597, Faustbuch 1587, Fortunatus 1509, Ambraser Liederbuch 1582, Karsthans 1521, etc.) were dated by hand from edition titles/known publication dates, and Johannes Plavius (197 poems) set to approximate 1630. Remaining undated works (Kuhn, Grimm, Schambach, Arent, 18th-19th c. anonymous anthologies, ancient authors in translation) are not period texts and were not harvested; a few undated 16th-17th c. items (Pickelherings Spiel, Muenchner Spiel vom sterbenden Menschen, Kraeutlein Toback) were left out.

Because tgsearch work-level dates are author spans, the 1450-1700 selection is approximate: some later-printed texts by in-window authors may be included and some in-window texts by authors with wider spans are excluded.

Other public TextGrid projects (work counts from tgsearch-public; facet shows only the 10 largest projects, so smaller ones may be missing): adso (TGPR-45581d1b-1326-48e5-e607-69d5da02b3f3, Spanish Golden Age poetry): 2,321 works dated wholly 1450-1700 (+102 straddling), e.g. Herrera 320, Cetina 248, Villamediana 203, Argensola 158; textbox_32 (TGPR-4b8bf6c0-e82e-285f-9f69-66bee06b5e2f, French theatre, Corneille/Scarron/Moliere): 98 in-window works (+290 later); a second project also named Digitale Bibliothek (TGPR-e4123902-183d-2f76-9b8f-2abbc96391d9): 9 in-window (Heinrich Julius, Grimmelshausen, Ziegler), 440 later, 334 undated; Kolimo+ (41,298 works, 19th-20th c., none in window), Multilingual Bible Corpus (4,912, out of window), ELTeC (1,262, 19th c.), gretil (1,171, Sanskrit), Goethe Farbenlehre reception (1,340), American Drama Corpus (771, 19th-20th c.): 0 in-window

Appended projects (same dating rule: work dateOfCreation range wholly within 1450-1700, year = midpoint; translations excluded by edition title): adso: 2321 in-window works, 2321 editions, 2321 texts added, 0 translations skipped; textbox32: 98 in-window works, 98 editions, 98 texts added, 0 translations skipped; digbib2: 9 in-window works, 0 editions, 0 texts added, 0 translations skipped. adso years are author spans (e.g. Herrera), so approximate; textbox32 and the second Digitale Bibliothek project likewise.
